result.question: Quantos hospitais atenderam casos de UTI em 2020?
result.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "CNES") FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2020;
result.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h."CNES") AS total_hospitais FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2020;
